problem: A batch operator runs the export command after records are processed. When any record fails, the command still reports a clean run, so the operator automation does not retry the failed batch.
outcome: The batch operator receives a reliable batch result, meaning exactly one result names every completed batch and reports failure whenever that batch contains a failed record.
acceptance: Every completed batch produces exactly one result.
Each result carries the completed batch identifier.
A completed batch containing any failed record reports failure.
non_goals: Changing how individual records are processed
